sites.loses: nothing observable: the wrap is fully transparent per-request — any configured model/provider that matches Router's catalog (e.g. openai/gpt-5.5) routes through Router, and every other request (local providers like ollama/lmstudio/vllm, azure-openai deployments, openrouter's non-catalog model ids, and any future provider added to config.yaml) still goes to its original base_url/api_key unchanged.
sites.why: the OpenAI client here is constructed dynamically inside on_message (llmcord.py:156) using whichever provider/model the server admin has selected via config.yaml or the /model command, so there is no single static client to migrate — wrapping the construction point lets every request attempt Router first and fall back per-request based on whether its model is a Router catalog id, without hardcoding any one provider's behavior.
